method.hand: EAN from the official e-katanalotis basket list (16 Jun 2026) linked to a posokanei.gov.gr product id only when brand and pack size match, the same price was reported at the same chain by at least 2 chains (and at least half the chains compared) within 8 days, no chain differs by more than 20%, the link is unique both ways, and each pair was checked by hand (brand, variant, size) during the FoodScan 72 build; 7 pairs were rejected. Never used for any other barcode.
method.auto-exact: Automatic exact match: the barcode record (e-katanalotis, Bazaar e-shop listing or Open Food Facts) and the observatory product have the same brand, the same pack size, every descriptive word of the barcode record, the same numbers (fat %, number, count) and no extra variant word (light, zero, flavour, ...); the same number of units in the pack; exactly one observatory product qualifies, every source agrees, and no other barcode claims it. Where the barcode has same-week shelf prices (e-katanalotis, Bazaar), they must not point to a sibling product and must sit within 0.67-1.5x of the chosen product. Measured precision: see the release notes.
